commands.name: testStatsEnd
commands.description: ends a test session for recording stats and exits the game

commands.name: testStatsBegin
commands.description: starts a test session for recording stats

commands.name: playEvents
commands.description: playEvents <name> playback sys events F12 will stop playback

commands.name: restartmaphere
commands.description: restarts the current map and teleports the player back to the current position

commands.name: campaign
commands.description: loads a map via mapinfo decl

commands.name: stripStrings
commands.description: strip strings containing the specified substring or prefix

commands.name: find
commands.description: finds all system elements containing the given search string

commands.name: testImage
commands.description: displays the given image centered on screen

commands.name: colorGradingShot
commands.description: Takes a screenshot with the color grading inset

commands.name: buddha
commands.description: Toggle buddha mode on player / NPCs.

commands.name: god
commands.description: Toggle god mode on player / NPCs.

commands.name: clearDebugPoints
commands.description: empties the list of debug points

commands.name: popDebugPoint
commands.description: removes a debug point from the list of debug points

commands.name: pushDebugPoint
commands.description: adds a debug point to the list of debug points

commands.name: randomTest
commands.description: superficial test of random number generators

commands.name: prevAI
commands.description: move debug target to the prev monster

commands.name: nextAI
commands.description: move debug target to the next monster

commands.name: nextActiveAI
commands.description: move debug target to the next active (alive and not hidden) monster

commands.name: killEntity
commands.description: removes the entity with the given name, 'kill entityname' will remove that single entity, 'kill all entityname' removes all entities matching the class of the given name

commands.name: teleport
commands.description: teleports the player to an entity location

commands.name: reexportDecls
commands.description: reparses and saves decls of a specific type

commands.name: writeImage
commands.description: Writes a tga for a given image

commands.name: arkIggySubtitleLevel
commands.description: Setup a subtitles display level. 0 = none; 1 = main only; 2 all.

commands.name: arkBind
commands.description: binds a command to a key

commands.name: arkBindSecondary
commands.description: binds a command to a key

commands.name: arkUnbind
commands.description: unbinds any command from a key

commands.name: arkUnbindCurrentSet
commands.description: unbinds any commands from the current binding set

commands.name: arkUnbindKeyboard
commands.description: unbinds any command from a keyboard keys

commands.name: arkUnbindMouse
commands.description: unbinds any command from the mouse

commands.name: arkUnbindJoypad
commands.description: unbinds any command from a joypad buttons

commands.name: arkUnbindAll
commands.description: unbinds any commands from all the binding sets

commands.name: writeEntitiesFile
commands.description: writes out a production build .entities file for the specified map

commands.name: writeEntitiesFileWithError
commands.description: writes out a production build .entities file for the specified map

commands.name: print
commands.description: Prints the arguments to the console

commands.name: con_watch
commands.description: adds a new console watch - displays per frame results of console var/function printed output

commands.name: con_unwatch
commands.description: removes the specified console watch. Specify 'all' to remove all watches.

commands.name: cvarAdd
commands.description: adds a value to a cvar

commands.name: cvarRandom
commands.description: sets a cvar to a random value

commands.name: addWrap
commands.description: adds to a cvar, with wrapping

commands.name: addClamp
commands.description: adds to a cvar, with clamping

commands.name: cvarMultiply
commands.description: multiplies a cvar by a value

commands.name: reset
commands.description: resets a cvar to it's default value

commands.name: cvar_restart
commands.description: restarts the cvar system, defaulting all cvars

commands.name: cvarsModified
commands.description: reports cvars modified since the last call

commands.name: scheduleVideo
commands.description: Schedules the video so it starts next frame

commands.name: RestartFromMemoryCheckpoint
commands.description: Restart from the last memory checkpoint

commands.name: LoadGame
commands.description: Quick load, or load the specified slot number

commands.name: Ansel_PlayerVisible
commands.description: Shows/hides the player for Nvidia Ansel.

commands.name: wait
commands.description: delays remaining buffered commands one or more frames

commands.name: vstr
commands.description: inserts the current value of a cvar as command text
